dict.Combinații gata făcute de Umed, Încărcar: Ready-made combinations of Wet, Load and Mix
dict.După fiecare trăsătură pensula pornește: After each stroke the brush starts clean, without the colours picked up from the picture
dict.După fiecare trăsătură pensula se umple: After each stroke the brush is refilled with its colour
dict.Golește pensula acum: trăsătura următoar: Empty the brush now: the next stroke only spreads the colours of the picture (when it does not clean itself)
dict.Pensula ia culorile din toate straturile: The brush picks up colours from all visible layers, not just the selected layer
dict.Umple pensula acum cu culoarea ei (când: Fill the brush with its colour now (when it does not load itself)
